# Generated archive fixtures

Archive samples are generated by `internal/testdatafixture` so binary `.gz` and
`.zip` files do not need to be committed. Run:

```sh
go run ./cmd/zrep-testdata -root /tmp/zrep-testdata
```

Then search:

```sh
zrep -F --search-compressed ERROR /tmp/zrep-testdata/archives/app.log.gz
```
